subject.title: [Feature]: Allow agents to resolve Slack channel IDs to names via channel-info/channel-list

question: Should Slack channel discovery land as a focused `channel-info`/`channel-list` split now, or wait for a broader Slack action-surface decision?
rationale: The feature is valid and source-reproducible, but the available implementation paths are closed unmerged, broad, partial, or a conflicting fork PR, so automation should not queue another branch without maintainer direction.

options.title: Split focused discovery work
options.body: Land only Slack `channel-info` and `channel-list` with read authorization, docs, and tests, leaving search and broader actions for separate review.

options.title: Adopt the fork after narrowing
options.body: Use the open fork PR only if it is rebased, made target-repo reviewable, and extended or split to cover `channel-info` safely.

options.title: Defer Slack discovery
options.body: Keep this feature request open until maintainers are ready to expand Slack's action surface.

recommendation.title: Split focused discovery work
recommendation.body: Land only Slack `channel-info` and `channel-list` with read authorization, docs, and tests, leaving search and broader actions for separate review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent Slack action/runtime/docs history and owned the broad overlapping Slack action-parity attempt.
